newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Goodwill sets warrants for 29 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Goodwill sets warrants for 29 mln shrs.

text.p: Property and financial services group Goodwill Investment (Holdings) Ltd said it had agreed to issue 29 million warrants conferring rights to subscribe up to 29 million new shares at HK$3.50 each.

Each warrant, to be issued at HK$0.50 each, would give holders the right to subscribe to one new company share between April 17, 1997 and September 30, 1998. The total purchase price of the shares would amout to HK$101.50 million, it said.
Dealing in the warrants is expected to begin on April 23.
The company said the net proceeds of HK$13.5 million raised from the warrant issue would be used for working capital.
Goodwill shares rose HK$0.15 to HK$3.40 in mid-morning on Monday.
